F Firm L produces 134 units, so total industry output is Q = 134 + qF, where qF is firm F's quantity.

F Firm L chooses first, so it knows firm F will respond. The inverse demand is P = 178 − Q.

F Firm L maximizes profit by choosing qL to maximize πL = (178 − Q) × qL = (178 − qL − qF) × qL

F Firm F observes qL and chooses qF to maximize πF = (178 − Q) × qF = (178 − qL − qF) × qF

F Firm F's first-order condition: dπF/dqF = (178 − qL − qF) − qF = 0

F Firm F's optimal response: qF = (178 − qL)/2

F If qL = 134, then qF = (178 − 134)/2 = 44/2 = 22
